feeds.title: Alex Coghe Photography
feeds.description: Alex Coghe is a Writer and Documentary Photographer specialized in taking pictures with a straight approach and focused on documenting the human condition. Alex is also a full time educator and instructor, producing and teaching his own workshops and photography expeditions in Italy and Mexico.

feeds.title: Julie Harris Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm a reactive photographer rather than a proactive one. I'm making my best work when I can come into a session and let people, both big and little, be who they are. I want you to see LIFE in all its glorious messiness in the images we make. I want you to be proud of it all. Life is a miracle. And one that is always dynamic.

feeds.title: Natalie Gibbs Photography Blog
feeds.description: Wedding and portrait photography by Natalie Gibbs, based in Christiansburg, Virginia.

feeds.title: Katie Dervin Documentary Photographer Blog
feeds.description: Documentary Photographer based in Manchester, North West of England.

feeds.title: France Leclerc
feeds.description: Travel and Documentary Photography Blog. I like to photograph people, to capture 'moments' in their lives, from cultural rituals to daily life activities.

feeds.title: Dean Raphael Blog
feeds.description: I believe in the power of finding light in unseen places. For over a decade I have been passionately pursuing my craft. I have come to believe, through my own experience, we can always find the beauty of life in what others might miss. This is my gift. In finding that light and seeing that beauty, I find happiness and love in places that already exist. It is my honor to share that gift with the world and to share it directly with you.

feeds.title: Yana Klein Blog
feeds.description: Yana Klein is a portrait and lifestyle photographer with passion for natural light portraiture. My photography sessions are about you and are planned to create a visual narrative of your life's most memorable moments. My goal is to create emotive imagery that speaks to the viewer, captures your unique personality, your connections and relationships, your emotions and behaviours

feeds.title: Jenny Harper Photography Blog
feeds.description: Jenny Harper is a Staffordshire wedding photographer and family portrait photographer specialising in candid documentary lifestyle photography.

feeds.title: Annie Hall Photography Blog
feeds.description: San Francisco Bay Area photographer. Honest, documentary photography that focuses on story and moments for passionate, down-to-earth people in love.

feeds.title: Shannon M West Photography
feeds.description: A Documentary family and portrait photography blog. I aim to capture the beauty and hilarity of life. I love COLOR! I love movement and magic moments.

feeds.title: Stanburg

feeds.title: Jonathan Desmond Photography Blog
feeds.description: This is my documentary photography journal where I share photographs and write about my wedding photography work, thoughts, contemplations, travels and other projects I'm working on.  I love sharing stories through photography and shooting films.

feeds.title: Jessica Collins Fine Art Photography
feeds.description: Sonoma County Photographer Specializing in Documentary Photography for Children, High school Seniors, and Family.

feeds.title: Evolylla Photography Blog
feeds.description: Wedding photography blog featuring documentary-style wedding photography by Toronto wedding photographer Ally Ho. I'm Toronto wedding photographer, Ally. Nothing fascinates me more than the different shapes and forms of how two people connect and show intimacy. As your wedding photographer, my goals are to make the process effortless for you and document the honest moments that create the distinctive narrative of your wedding day.

feeds.title: Don Denton
feeds.description: Don Denton is an editorial and documentary photographer living on the western edge of Canada in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada. He makes a living photographing for newspapers, magazines and agencies.

feeds.title: Moment Junkie | The Best of Wedding Documentary Photography
feeds.description: A Wedding Documentary Photography Blog. The concept and impetus behind this blog is so awesome. I love the moments in documentary photography: the revealing and in-between bits flesh out the story of the day or the characterization in the stories the photographs tell.

feeds.title: John Free Photography Blog
feeds.description: John Free is a social documentary/street photographer who lives in Los Angeles. His photographic essays range from railroad tramps in California to automobile abstracts to London and Paris street life.
